exp3-comb-4-junctions-40-ants-scent.trac: By about tick 1,000 the scent colony runs at its ceiling (about 62 food per 500 ticks), walking straight past all four branches. 695 food by tick 6,000.
exp3-comb-4-junctions-40-ants-no-scent.t: Ants turn into a branch at half of all forks, all run long. 167 food.
exp3-comb-12-junctions-40-ants-scent.tra: Twelve branches. Almost nothing arrives for 3,000 ticks (19 food); the trail forms around tick 3,500, then the colony climbs toward its ceiling. 347 food.
Ants wander the dead ends all run. 32 food.
exp2-comb-0-junctions-40-ants-scent.trac: A plain corridor. Ants can only go forward, so the scent is irrelevant. 720 food, the same as scent off.
exp4-maze-35-cells-48-ants-scent.trace.j: A single highway forms from nest to food. 711 food.
exp4-maze-35-cells-48-ants-no-scent.trac: Same maze, same food, scent off: ants find the food only by chance. 19 food, about a thirty-seventh as much.
retracted-ridge-15-cells-128-ants-capped: Watch the food counter: the source is empty at tick 3,060, and the colony delivers nothing after that. Its score is stuck at the 2,500 cap.
The twin keeps delivering all run (156 food). Dividing a capped score by this is what made the fake ridge.
exp5-maze-55-cells-16-ants-18000-ticks-s: Food 55 cells out. Nothing arrives for 3,000 ticks; the trail forms around tick 4,000. At tick 6,000, where earlier runs stopped, it has 68 food. By 18,000 it has 448.
exp5-maze-55-cells-16-ants-18000-ticks-n: The same seed with scent off: 24 food in 18,000 ticks.
exp5-comb-12-junctions-10-ants-54000-tic: Ten ants, twelve forks. A trickle for 20,000 ticks (22 food by tick 18,000); the trail holds from about tick 22,000 and then the colony runs near its ceiling. 1,051 food by 54,000. Use the replay slider.
exp6-comb-12-junctions-20-ants.trace.jso: The base colony: 37 food by tick 6,000, trail forming around 7,000, 603 food by 18,000.
exp6-comb-12-junctions-20-ants-3x-louder: The same 20 ants, each laying three times as much scent. The trail looks stronger but forms later, around tick 11,000. 460 food.
exp6-comb-12-junctions-60-ants.trace.jso: Three times the ants, the same total scent as the loud colony. Its trail forms by tick 3,000. 2,907 food.
exp7-maze-40-cells-evaporation-0.005.tra: The default decay rate: a steady trail. 440 food.
exp7-maze-40-cells-evaporation-0.05.trac: Ten times faster decay: the trail never holds. 25 food.
exp8-comb-40-cells-gland-1800.trace.json: Enough scent for 30 cells of trail on a 40-cell path, so returning ants run dry 10 cells short of the nest. The colony still works, at 587 food.
exp8-comb-40-cells-gland-2400.trace.json: Enough for exactly 40 cells: the food trail reaches the nest. 703 food, the plateau.
